category_title: Students with low fine motor skills unable to use traditional drawing tools or computer mice
scenario_title: Drawing geometric objects at the concrete-experiential level
minimal_context: The student is attempting to draw geometric objects independently using a computer mouse.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's draw a square on the screen. Go ahead and use the computer mouse to draw the lines.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks stressed) I have difficulties using a computer with a mouse. I am not an active user of computers.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just give it a try and see what you can do.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Attempts to move the mouse) I am less precise in determining the direction and intensity of the movement. I can't control the speed.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep trying to move it to connect the corners.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I cannot draw unaided. Can you just hold the mouse and draw it following my instructions instead?

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Let's draw a square on the screen. Go ahead and use the computer mouse to draw the lines.

STUDENT: (Looks stressed) I have difficulties using a computer with a mouse. I am not an active user of computers.

TUTOR: Just give it a try and see what you can do.

STUDENT: (Attempts to move the mouse) I am less precise in determining the direction and intensity of the movement. I can't control the speed.

TUTOR: Keep trying to move it to connect the corners.

STUDENT: I cannot draw unaided. Can you just hold the mouse and draw it following my instructions instead?

task.learning_goal: Successfully pass through all stages of development of geometric concepts

context.materials: Paper-and-pen, computer with mouse and keyboard, Tangible User Interface (TUI) blocks, desktop, computer screen
context.social_setting: Collaboration among all students, presence of an assistant

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Attempting to draw geometric objects independently using paper-and-pen activities or a computer with mouse and keyboard as the interface
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Less precise in ability to determine the direction and intensity of movement handling descent, loading and speed; relies on assistant to draw following their instructions
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Reduced motivation for geometry tasks that require fine motor skills

behavior_patterns.condition: In computer-supported activities using standard mouse and keyboard
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Excluded from active involvement at the concrete-experiential level
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Lack confidence and are stressed because they are not active users of computers
Problems in the emotional and social areas
